parallel_groups: 各执行者可同时启动独立命令；本轮锁不受旧二槽锁约束。组内卡顺序由各执行者安排。
outputs: experiments/v4/runs/ext-UNIQUE/；每run源/卡/参数只读快照、原始官方输出、manifest、metrics及包装源码归档
holdout_gate: 新卡仅N5允许；需Root明确冻结后在extension/evaluation/N5_AUTHORIZATION.json写authorized_by=Root和authorized_run_ids列表；当前不创建该授权。
parameter_semantics: 沿用原harness全部CLI；--exclusive在本轮取得全部六槽。原二槽harness、官方runner、评分器、策略文件均不修改。
case_metadata: Optional config.case_id/config.reference_id or extension/results/run_index.json {runs:{run_id:{case_id,reference_id}}}; defaults to config family:variant and D-linear
reference_policy: D-linear same-card tree hash only; reused six old controls are separate reference_rows; N1 verification not an independent sample
aggregation_scope: ext-* only; never invoke original aggregator/main to update old all_runs
n5_run_gate: Root must explicitly freeze, then write extension/evaluation/N5_AUTHORIZATION.json with authorized_by=Root and authorized_run_ids array. This entry never creates permission on its own.

N5_batch.parallel_policy: all 13 strategy groups scheduled together; four cards serial within each group; shared global six-slot lease
